5.1 ACCESS AND INVESTIGATION
Prior to the Closing Date, and upon reasonable notice from Buyer, each Seller shall, and shall cause each Acquired Company to, (a) afford Buyer and its Representatives and prospective lenders and their Representatives (collectively, “Buyer Group”) full and free access, during regular business hours, to each Acquired Company’s personnel, assets, Contracts, and Records, (b) furnish Buyer Group with copies of all such Contracts and Records as Buyer may reasonably request, (c) furnish Buyer Group with such additional financial, operating, and other relevant data and information as Buyer may reasonably request, and (d) otherwise cooperate and assist, to the extent reasonably requested by Buyer, with Buyer’s investigation of the business, condition (financial or otherwise), assets, results of operations, or prospects of each Acquired Company. In addition, Buyer shall have the right to have the Real Property and the tangible personal property of each Acquired Company inspected by Buyer Group, at Buyer’s sole cost and expense, including the performance of subsurface or other intrusive testing.
